issues.quote: The human plateau began to budge.
The posts flew through feeds like hotcakes
Two hundred thousand viewers instantly jumped to two hundred and fifty.
Every new thousand took Freya's breath away.
*"Do you have kids?"* a stranger asked. *"How do you succeed when you have four of them?"*
Still, fame brings responsibility—the questions took a sharp turn
